claims.claim: B is administering a vision or reading assessment to A
claims.attribute: B is conducting a vision/reading test for A

evidence.quote: I can only read the first three lines

claims.adjudication_reason: Turn 7 ('this one is worse') and Turn 9 ('I can only read the first three lines') together strongly presuppose B is conducting a vision/reading assessment. The comparison between items and the line-reading task are consistent with a structured test administered by B.

claims.claim: B presented A with a multi-line text or chart to read
claims.attribute: B provided a reading material with at least three lines to A

evidence.quote: I can only read the first three lines

claims.adjudication_reason: Turn 9 'I can only read the first three lines' presupposes a multi-line text or chart was presented. The definite 'the first three lines' implies a known set of lines with more beyond three.

claims.claim: B presented A with more than one test item or chart
claims.attribute: B administered multiple items in the assessment
claims.adjudication_reason: Turn 7 'this one is worse' presupposes a prior comparable item existed ('this one' vs. a previous one). The comparative 'worse' requires at least two items.

claims.claim: B asked A about when their vision problems began
claims.attribute: B inquired about the onset timeline of A's visual difficulties

evidence.quote: Two years ago . At that time I had no problems.

claims.adjudication_reason: Turn 3 'Two years ago' is a direct answer to a temporal question. The follow-up 'At that time I had no problems' confirms the question was about when vision issues started or when a prior exam occurred. B must have asked a 'when' question.

claims.claim: B gave A an instruction or proposal that A agreed to proceed with
claims.attribute: B directed A to perform a task, which A accepted
claims.adjudication_reason: Turn 5 'All right' is an agreement token, presupposing B proposed or instructed something that A consented to. This is a genuine E2 presupposition from the acceptance marker.
